    41	#include <assimp/cimport.h>
    42	#include <assimp/Importer.hpp>
    43	#include <assimp/Exporter.hpp>
    44	#include <assimp/scene.h>

    47	using namespace Assimp;
    48	
    49	extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t dataSize) {
    50	#ifdef _DEBUG
    51	    aiLogStream stream = aiGetPredefinedLogStream(aiDefaultLogStream_STDOUT, nullptr);
    52	    aiAttachLogStream(&stream);
    53	#endif
    54	
    55	    Importer importer;
    56	    unsigned int flags = aiProcessPreset_TargetRealtime_Quality | aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure;
    57	    const aiScene *sc = importer.ReadFileFromMemory(data, dataSize, flags, nullptr);
    58	
    59	    if (sc == nullptr) {
    60	        return 0;
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    Exporter exporter;
    64	    exporter.ExportToBlob(sc, "fbx");
    65	
    66	#ifdef _DEBUG
    67	    aiDetachLogStream(&stream);
    68	#endif
    69	
    70	    return 0;
    71	}
